name: AK32L - Plug-In Gas Detector (CO, Combustible Gas, Temperature, Humidity), Carbon Monoxide & Gas Leak Alarm
highlights: Both Ways a Flame Can Fail — An unburnt leak and incomplete combustion are two different failures with two different sensors. This configuration watches for both from one socket.
The Complete Gas-Kitchen Fit — A gas hob can leak before it lights and produce carbon monoxide once it does. Fitting one device instead of two halves the installation and the sockets used.
Electrochemical CO, Semiconductor Gas — Each channel on the sensor class the job calls for.
110–240 V, US and EU Pins — Permanent mains power, no battery to go flat.
120 Per Carton — 520 × 505 × 355 mm outer carton, shared across every AK32 variant.
